# SP Mobile Detailing

SP Mobile Detailing is a premium mobile car detailing service operating in Maine, owned and operated by Ahmad Alsaleh.
We bring exterior washes, interior details, paint decontamination, ceramic sealants, and headlight restoration directly to the customer's driveway or workplace.

## Service Areas
- Waterville, ME & surrounding areas 
- Portland, ME & surrounding areas
- South Portland, ME & surrounding areas
- Bangor, ME & surrounding areas
- Lewiston, ME & surrounding areas
- Augusta, ME & surrounding areas
